text:
izzy: saw a few rows in the internal dashboard that clearly belong to another org. surfaced after the lightweight prefetch rollout this morning. :frowning:
omar: can you paste the exact repro and a screenshot?
izzy: dashboard link: https://console.internal/dash/metric/77?range=6h - switch orgs rapidly, you can catch 'payment errors' from org 902 showing in org 47 for ~15s.
rene: which service owns the prefetch envelope now? last refactor moved it from renderer -> prefetch-proxy.
sara: prefetch-proxy v1.8.0 deployed at 2026-03-20T06:00Z. we also enabled envelope dedupe to improve cache hit rates.
izzy: HAR shows response headers: `X-Prefetch-Org: 902` but request had `X-Console-Org: 47`. UI rendered envelope.headers directly.
omar: that implies one of two issues: (A) cache key omitted org_id, or (B) envelope headers were mutated after read. either can cause cross-tenant exposure.
rene: quick glance at the PR: we made `org_id` optional for panels labeled `staticish` to reduce card churn. maybe misclassification.
sara: mitigation plan: (1) mark metric/77 as strict-cache != true (2) invalidate prefetch entries for metric/77 (3) enable strict namespacing flag for prefetch-proxy in staging.
ops-bot: deploy event: prefetch-proxy v1.8.0 rolled at 2026-03-20T06:00:12Z (hash: e3a4b8f).
omar: also add a defensive runtime check: if envelope.headers.org != request.org then drop envelope and fetch live. cheap and safe.
izzy: agree. we need to stop rendering mismatched envelopes immediately.
rene: will draft a tiny hotfix that refuses to serve cached envelopes with an `org` header unless the cache key included that org. also add a metric `prefetch_cache_org_mismatch` so we can measure scope.
sara: feature flag approach: `PREFETCH_NAMESPACING_STRICT` default off, enable for staging and 10% prod. ops can ramp.
ops-bot: feature flag `prefetch-namespacing-strict` created and enabled for 5% traffic at 2026-03-20T07:10:00Z.
omar: telemetry consideration: if leaked rows were rendered, downstream billing and alerts may have misattributed events. add `leaked_row_source_org` to the audit event so we can unmix counts.
izzy: can we also search logs for `envelope_org != session_org` over last 24h and produce sample keys? i'll attach to the incident ticket.
rene: yes, i'll run a quick query and post findings. if this is limited to the dedupe flow we can contain it.
sara: longer term: make envelope opaque in cache (no headers), keep org metadata only as separate cache metadata that isn't serialized into the render path. avoids accidental render-time leakage.
omar: +1. API debate: does making envelope opaque break any clients expecting headers? probably only internal render flow, should be fine but needs coordination with renderer team.
izzy: customer-impact check: i only saw it on internal staging, not sure about prod. ops-bot alerted one leaked_row_count for org 47 at 2026-03-20T07:15:42Z.
ops-bot: alert: leaked_row_count > 0 for org 47 at 2026-03-20T07:15:42Z. paging eng-platform on-call.
izzy: i'm oncall and will hold the paging.
rene: short-term rollout: push hotfix to drop mismatched envelopes and enable strict namespacing in staging. then run synthetic fast-switch test (om 200 rps) to validate.
sara: i'll owner the staging flag push and the cache invalidation job.
omar: make sure prefetch cache key includes: service, panel_id, org_id, auth_fingerprint, panel_version. add unit tests for parallel responses with mismatched metadata.
izzy: thanks all. i've put a short repro script in the ticket and will follow up with HARs and screenshots. update thread when staging shows zero `prefetch_cache_org_mismatch`.
